However, its 1,593 seed lines often function as implementation inventories, with repeated explanations and uneven abstraction. The final collection preserves much of this density across 78 diagrams and 2,645 lines. Expansion, placement and peripheral selection belong to later phases; Phase 2's contribution was the detailed, sometimes overgeneralized material those phases inherited.","strengths":["The seeds establish useful identities and boundaries. diagrams lines 3–6 distinguish diagram, revision and local content identities; canvas lines 112–138 separate composition, exact revision bindings and personal view; storage lines 122–123 distinguish workspace and catalog publication. These distinctions remain visible in the corresponding final central diagrams.","Grouping adapts to several subjects successfully. source uses binding, mapped evidence, access, definitions and inspection; contexts separates conversation values, library operations, durable records, evidence and diagram bindings. Their final canvases retain these coherent functional divisions rather than organizing by filenames.","Important workflow distinctions survive compression: generation lines 66–82 separate prepared output from application acknowledgement; changes lines 32–35 separate workflow completion from acceptance; evals lines 67–74 distinguish retained output from accepting a proposal. These provide strong foundations for the final generation/batch, changes/review and evals/retain diagrams.","Ownership detail is especially useful where it explains behavior: editor lines 28–34 separate visible canvases from session and editor lifetimes; chat lines 82–87 distinguish active candidate controllers from retained histories. Retain exact limits selectively when their consequence is important, rather than treating every available implementation detail as presentation-worthy."},{"evidence":"generation repeats retained-output retry behavior in seed lines 26–30, 66–82, 84–94 and 112–119; final central lines 45–60 and 73–76 still repeat it, with further treatment in batch and lifetime. agent-api repeats mutation recovery across seed lines 42–46, 79–83 and 116–119, retained in final central lines 37–39, 57–60 and 79–81. editor repeats controller state ownership and publication under seed lines 7–15, 21–34, 53–60 and 77–89.","impact":"Separate structural, call, ownership and dependency passes often retell the same mechanism instead of adding a distinct insight. These overlaps persist in final diagrams/source lines 19–26, generation/validation lines 18–23, canvas/restore lines 25–31, storage/central lines 17–38 and editor/boundary lines 2–17. source and contexts also discuss related evidence with different hashes: source seed lines 20–23 and 36–37 versus contexts lines 13–18 and 102–107.","impact":"Individual canvases are reasonably self-contained, but the collection lacks a clear division between the authoritative explanation of a mechanism and a caller's view of it. Readers repeatedly encounter similar flows while having to infer whether a version, hash, revision or acknowledgement refers to the same object.","recommendation":"Coordinate the seeds as a collection. Assign each shared mechanism a primary explanatory point and retain concise caller/callee contracts elsewhere. At handoffs, name the transferred object and identity scope explicitly—for example, document version, diagram revision, workspace revision, descriptor hash or source fingerprint. Preserve local context without repeating the full downstream implementation."},{"evidence":"runtime seed lines 83–90 nest LayoutTemplateService, ReferenceGenerationService, JudgementService and ExperimentService beneath EvalRunService inside an ownership-labelled service graph; final runtime/eval lines 2–11 distinguish constructor inputs from collaborators assigned afterward. generation seed lines 54–59 place sequential variant generation under 'Install according to operation'; final generation/central lines 33–42 separate preparation from installation. changes seed line 32 presents 'runAgentWorkflow: analyze -> materialize -> validate', whereas final changes/central lines 20–21 and changes/run lines 11–16 distinguish workflow execution from subsequent service validation.","impact":"Tree nesting and arrows sometimes blur injected dependency, ownership, execution sequence and conceptual grouping. The final outputs explicitly repair several such ambiguities. This is a Phase 2 relationship-modelling problem, independent of later layout; the supplied outputs do not establish source-level errors beyond these differences in representation.","recommendation":"Regenerate these branches with explicit relationship verbs and correctly scoped stages. Use containment only where it communicates a real grouping or ownership relationship; identify constructor inputs, assigned collaborators and callbacks separately when that distinction matters. Keep preparation, invocation, validation and publication boundaries clear without requiring a fixed set of relationship categories."},{"evidence":"Several seed statements are broader than their final counterparts. canvas seed line 55 says 'One gesture -> one saved checkpoint', while final canvas/central line 38 allows an unchanged view-only early return. chat seed lines 86–87 state settlement cleanup generally, while final chat/isolate lines 24–26 identify a preceding save whose failure can bypass that cleanup. contexts seed lines 60–61 say stale comment hashes fail, while final contexts/retry lines 15–19 distinguish receipt replay from a new comment's freshness check. analysis seed line 24 says the schema retains 'exported metadata'; final analysis/names lines 20–22 distinguish an optional field from its population.","impact":"Broad summaries can turn conditional behavior or schema capability into an apparent guarantee. These are observable differences between supplied outputs, not independently verified repository defects.","recommendation":"Preserve material qualifiers in Phase 2, especially around retries, cleanup, no-op behavior and supported-versus-produced data. Prefer a concise bounded claim over a universal statement that requires a later corrective peripheral."},{"evidence":"runtime seed lines 56–62 explicitly describe a shared CanvasApiProjection injected into live and agent services; final runtime/central lines 41–47 and runtime/context line 18 preserve that integration. agent-api seed lines 97–100 instead describes projection lifetime as the backend lifetime, while final agent-api/identity lines 21–24 says local defaults create separate instances and that supplied construction wiring does not prove sharing. Related evidence is also split between contexts final central line 77, which leaves fingerprint comparison to callers, and agent-api final central lines 91–93, which describes that caller-side status decision.","impact":"The collection contains complementary evidence, but point-local treatment leaves integration facts sounding unresolved in one canvas despite being presented elsewhere. The final projection disclaimer is a later-phase choice; Phase 2's missed opportunity was to encode the distinction between per-instance behavior and configured application wiring consistently across seeds.","recommendation":"Reconcile shared concepts across all seeds before regeneration completes. Describe projection maps as instance-owned in agent-api and identify runtime as the point establishing configured sharing. Likewise, connect context loading to caller-owned freshness checks through explicit boundary labels. Distinguish local evidence limits from collection-level integration evidence rather than flattening either into a universal claim."},{"evidence":"generation seed lines 19–22 gives runAgentWorkflow a top-level boundary despite stating that the supplied diagram runtime does not invoke it. The final generation canvas allocates a separate 16-line workflow diagram to that abstraction. Meanwhile, changes seed line 32 and final changes/run lines 11–16 show its relevant invocation. storage seed lines 149–153 similarly includes an 'Independent ImmutableRecords utility' while explicitly noting no calls from the pinned workspace/catalog implementations; final storage/blobs lines 14–20 expands it. contexts seed lines 76–89 already supplies a meaningful consumer of ImmutableRecords.","impact":"These inclusions suggest selection partly follows the available source bundle rather than the point's explanatory purpose. Explicit caveats prevent false integration claims, but disconnected utilities still compete with the active paths and encourage later peripheral expansion. The decision to allocate whole peripheral diagrams is downstream; their prominence originates in Phase 2.","recommendation":"Rank supporting abstractions by demonstrated relevance to the point. Give runAgentWorkflow its substantive explanation with changes and retain only a short scope note in generation. Explain immutable evidence storage where contexts consumes it, while keeping storage focused on its actual persistence paths and any useful contrast. Do not expand an unconnected helper merely because its implementation was supplied."}],"regenerationInstructions":"Regenerate all 13 seeds together, preserving their successful functional boundaries and distinctions among immutable content, live state, captured evidence and publication. Establish a clear purpose and abstraction level for each point; prioritize consequential relationships over inventories. Consolidate repeated mechanisms within seeds, designate primary explanations across points, and label handoffs with object and identity scope. Correct ambiguous nesting and stage boundaries, retain material conditions on guarantees, and distinguish local component behavior from application wiring. Downrank disconnected helpers and routine constants. Use subject-specific structures rather than a uniform template or branch count. Treat the supplied final refinements as evidence of presentation ambiguities to resolve, not as independently verified source facts; leave layout, peripheral counts and routing to later phases."}

|-- Workbench interface: EvalsPage
|   |-- Exposes prompt editing, run launch, output inspection, experiments and judgements

|   |-- Selected outputs -> comparison launcher -> comparison or judgement view
|   `-- [O] Local navigation, selections, unsaved edits and polling timers
|       |-- Active jobs trigger faster polling; completed outputs refresh the catalog view
|       `-- Unmount clears timers; late responses cannot update closed views
|
|-- [M] Versioned inputs: EvalPromptService + context and canvas boundaries
|   |-- Public: save, fork, resolve, archive and snapshot prompts
|   |   |-- Content changes append versions; expected base version prevents stale writes
|   |   |-- Forks and edited attempts retain parent version and content hash
|   |   `-- Internal: serialized writes, workflow/template validation and lineage cycle checks
|   |-- [C] resolve(promptId, version, workflow)
|   |   `-- Return stage text, template base, lineage and frozen cited reference text
|   |-- [D] Pinned run inputs [shared INPUTS]
|   |   |-- Prompt versions + stage text + cited and selected reference content
|   |   |-- AgentContext ID + content hash -> resolve sources -> verify hash before generation
|   |   |-- Canvas source + checkpoint -> CompareSessionService.capture()
|   |   |   `-- Copy selected endpoint and required diagram revisions; omit undo history

|   `-- [O] Run retains its captured meaning across later prompt and canvas edits
|       |-- Reruns reuse matching pins and remain under the original root run

|           `-- Canvas-only workflows create a context describing their pinned inputs
|
|-- [M] Run orchestration: EvalRunService
|   |-- Public: start, prepareForReview, launchPrepared, read, rename, cancel and delete
|   |-- Private: preparation, execution chains, validation, persistence and live-job maps
|   |-- Dependencies -> prompt resolver, context library, comparison capture,
|   |                  EvalRunStore, EvalRuntime and project catalog
|   |-- [C] start(request)
|   |   |-- Validate workflow bindings and request identity
|   |   |   `-- Same request ID + same hash -> existing run; different hash -> conflict
|   |   `-- Prepare [shared INPUTS] -> create cells -> persist queued run -> execute
|   |       |-- Ordinary cells = prompt versions x sample passes x workflow stages
|   |       |-- Independent chains use configured concurrency, default 3

|   |   |-- Roll-up -> r2 -> g2 attachment

|   |   |   `-- r2 failure -> mark g2 skipped

|   |   |-- Valid output -> materialize and retain result
|   |   |-- Validation failure -> retry with previous output + validation error
|   |   |   `-- At most 3 generation attempts; usage accumulates across responses
|   |   `-- Runtime failure or exhausted validation -> fail cell
|   |-- [M] Runtime adapter: AgentContextEvalRuntime implements EvalRuntime
|   |   |-- No session context -> delegate to CodexEvalRuntime
|   |   `-- Session context -> reuse persisted agent-session execution
|   |       |-- [D] Resolved context + composed prompt + supplementary inputs -> response
|   |       |-- Each invocation gets an independent session and audit ID
|   |       |   `-- Identical prefixes share a cache key, not another sample's answer
|   |       |-- Returns output, usage and session/context/cache provenance
|   |       `-- [O] Owns session, timeout, subscription and abort listener

|   |-- [O] Output retention [shared OUTPUTS]
|   |   |-- Single canvas -> catalog saves generated representation
|   |   |   `-- Run retains exact checkpoint snapshot; cell records provenance and usage
|   |   |-- Multi-canvas result -> full frozen documents in run; summary in cell
|   |   |-- History-coordinated result -> timeline/step reference into shared checkpoint store
|   |   `-- captureOutputResult() -> pin an external change-session proposal
|   |       |-- Requires matching project/version and an available output cell

|   `-- [O] Run lifecycle
|       |-- Serialized snapshot saves preserve update order; live state preserves renames

|       `-- Finished proposal trees [shared OUTPUTS] -> deterministic tree evaluator
|           `-- Save typed judgement -> attach judgement ID to experiment comparison
|
|-- [M] Comparison and assessment
|   |-- CompareSessionService exposes candidates, capture, create and createPinned
|   |   |-- Dependencies -> saved workspace records, generated canvas source and session repository
|   |   |-- [C] create(pairs) -> capture sources -> createPinned() -> store comparison session
|   |   |   `-- Request ID + content hash make repeated creation idempotent
|   |   |-- [D] Each pane needs its captured checkpoint and rendering revisions
|   |   |   |-- Whole-canvas pane -> stored viewport and optional focus targets
|   |   |   `-- Diagram pane -> matching revision plus validated slice/subtree selection
|   |   `-- [O] Session owns independent copies; later source edits do not alter comparison
|   |       `-- Repeated references to the same source share one captured copy within the session
|   `-- JudgementService exposes list, read, delete and typed result saves
|       |-- [C] Reconcile comparison sessions/jobs -> durable typed judgement records
|       |   |-- Canvas comparison, diagram comparison and comparison report
|       |   `-- Native saves also retain few-shot progress and deterministic change-tree results
|       |-- [D] Assessment = subject references + captured evidence + evaluator metadata + result
|       |   `-- Subject references connect back to run/cell provenance [shared OUTPUTS]
|       `-- [O] Judgement owns its attachments and may evaluate several runs
|           |-- Serialized reconciliation preserves deletion tombstones
|           `-- Deleting an active imported judgement also deletes its comparison job
|
`-- [M] Publication boundary: completed evaluation output -> project catalog
    |-- Public: promotionTargets, promotionSource and promoteOutput
    |-- [D] Promotion needs a finished cell [shared OUTPUTS] + destination + request signature
    |   `-- Resolve source from history artifact, frozen result or exact canvas checkpoint
    |-- [C] promoteOutput()
    |   |-- Existing matching receipt -> return receipt; signature mismatch -> conflict
    |   |-- Existing-canvas destination -> check settled target and expected revision

    |   `-- prepareOutputPromotion() -> projectCatalogs.publishOutputPromotion()
    |       `-- Supply documents, optional new canvas project and run/cell placement provenance
    `-- [O] Catalog owns publication and its receipt

{"ascii":"[M] Generation Evaluation Workbench
|-- Product surface: EvalsPage
|   |-- Edit prompt versions, launch runs, inspect outputs and compare selected results
|   |-- Navigate experiments and typed judgements; manage references and layout templates
|   `-- [O] UI owns navigation, selections, draft state and polling timers
|       `-- Polling preserves local updates; cleanup stops timers and ignores late responses
|
|-- Prepare reproducible inputs
|   |-- EvalPromptService exposes versioned save, fork and resolve
|   |   |-- Stage text, template base and parent links define a prompt version
|   |   |-- Updating requires the current base version; earlier version text is retained
|   |   `-- Internal validation checks workflow contracts, references and lineage cycles
|   |-- [D] A prepared EvalRun needs workflow bindings + model settings + sample count
|   |   |-- Prompt ID/version -> captured stage text, template base and cited reference text
|   |   |-- AgentContext ID + contentHash -> context-library resolution at execution
|   |   |   `-- Resolved input must match the recorded hash before generation proceeds
|   |   |-- Canvas inputs -> CompareSessionService.capture(source)
|   |   |   |-- Source identity: documentId + optional viewId + checkpointId
|   |   |   |-- Copy selected checkpoint + required diagram revisions + presentation state
|   |   |   `-- Exclude undo archive; reject unavailable or changed selections
|   |   `-- When requested: selected references, prior alternatives, canvas set or layout geometry
|   `-- [O] Run retains captured inputs; later prompt/canvas edits do not rewrite them
|       |-- Reruns reuse matching pins and link to the original root run
|       `-- Outputs are associated with an AgentContext
|           `-- Canvas-only workflows create a context describing their captured inputs
|
|-- Execute samples: EvalRunService
|   |-- Public start / prepareForReview / launchPrepared separate preparation from execution
|   |   |-- start(request) -> prepare -> launchPrepared -> persist queued run -> execute
|   |   |-- prepareForReview returns captured inputs and cells without launching a model job
|   |   `-- Existing run ID + matching request hash -> reuse; different request -> conflict
|   |-- Internal scheduling and persistence stay behind the service boundary
|   |   |-- Ordinary cells identify prompt + sample pass + workflow stage
|   |   `-- Independent sample chains use bounded concurrency
|   |-- [C] Workflow determines the computation and its prerequisites
|   |   |-- Alternatives: context + optional template/prior outputs -> generated canvas
|   |   |-- Diagram-change proposal: context -> exact proposal text + display canvas
|   |   |   `-- Preserve proposal syntax errors for assessment instead of repairing them
|   |   |-- Linked canvases: context + captured canvas set -> frozen multi-canvas result
|   |   |-- Roll-up: generate r2 -> generate g2 attachment
|   |   |   `-- [D] g2 needs r2 output + parent history; failed r2 leaves g2 skipped
|   |   `-- Few-shot refinement delegates rounds and progress assessment to its executor
|   |-- [C] generateValidated -> EvalRuntime.generate -> workflow validator/materializer
|   |   |-- Valid response -> retain output and execution metadata
|   |   |-- Validation failure -> retry with previous response + validation error
|   |   |   `-- At most three generation attempts; accumulate returned usage
|   |   `-- Runtime failure or exhausted validation -> fail the cell
|   `-- Runtime boundary: AgentContextEvalRuntime implements EvalRuntime
|       |-- Without session context -> delegate to CodexEvalRuntime
|       `-- Session delivery, supported for diagram-change proposals
|           |-- Invoke persisted agent-session execution with resolved context + prompt
|           |-- Each invocation has an independent session; identical prefixes share cache keys
|           |-- Samples execute serially within this run; prior sample answers are not reused
|           |-- Return output + usage + sessionId/contextHash/cacheKey provenance
|           `-- [O] Prompt scope handles abort/timeout and releases session resources on exit
|
|-- Retain evidence independently of accepting changes
|   |-- Output identity: runId + cellKey
|   |   |-- Generated canvas -> catalog representation + canvasId/checkpointId on the cell
|   |   |   `-- Run also retains an exact endpoint snapshot
|   |   |-- Multi-canvas output -> full frozen documents in run; summary on cell
|   |   `-- History-coordinated output -> timelineId/stepId into shared checkpoint storage
|   |-- [C] captureOutputResult(runId, cellKey, changeSessionId, expectedVersion)
|   |   |-- Requires matching project/session version and an eligible, unpinned output cell
|   |   |-- Same captured session/version -> return existing result; another pin -> conflict
|   |   `-- Capture proposal evidence without accepting changes or starting generation
|   `-- [O] Service owns active controllers/live runs; EvalRunStore retains saved snapshots
|       |-- Serialized saves preserve order; terminal cell outcomes determine final run status
|       |   `-- Some finished cells with other terminal outcomes -> partial run
|       |-- Restart fails unfinished local cells while retaining completed outputs
|       |   `-- Diagram-history recovery belongs to its external durable coordinator
|       `-- Deletion aborts local work, drains pending saves, archives outputs and tombstones run
|           `-- Deleted-run guard blocks later progress saves from restoring the record
|
|-- Organize and assess evidence
|   |-- ExperimentService groups phases, conditions, input cases, samples and attempts
|   |   |-- Stage outputs reference runId/cellKey; validation checks project and case membership
|   |   |-- [C] Save planned generation -> prepareForReview -> persist awaiting-approval review
